text: Welcome Bob to Northwind Labs! Bob, I am the engineering lead. Post questions here in #general and I will route them.
Thanks Alice, excited to be here. Where do I start?
Read the onboarding wiki first, then pair with Dave on your first ticket.
Heads up: the on-call rotation is changing. New schedule starts November 2 and handoffs become weekly instead of daily. Details to follow.
Lunch order for Friday goes out at 11:30, add your name to the sheet.
Reminder that some services will see maintenance windows this month. Watch #general for notices.
Why we picked PostgreSQL for orders: we need JSONB for order metadata and row-level locking for inventory holds. MySQL replication lag kept hurting us.
Agreed. Carol, you own the migration end to end. PR #42 has the plan.
Confirmed, I own it. Cutover is October 14 in the low-traffic window.
Open item: we still have no rollback plan for the Postgres cutover. Issue #44. Someone needs to rehearse it before October 14.
I will draft the rollback plan this week and rehearse on staging.
Rate limiter decision: token bucket in Redis, not a sliding window. Mobile clients send bursts and token bucket tolerates them. 100 requests per minute, burst of 20. PR #51.
Fine by me. Dave owns the limiter, including the Redis cluster sizing.
Yes, I own it and the Redis setup.
Why weekly on-call: daily handoffs caused pager fatigue and lost context between shifts. I own the new rotation and will publish the schedule. Issue #58.
Weekly is better for me. Starts November 2, handoff Monday 10:00 PT.
I am deprecating the v1 API. Sunset is December 1. I am accountable for customer comms, PR #63. Reason: v1 has no pagination limits and we cannot keep patching it.
I will add the portal banner for the v2 migration guide.
p99 dashboards are live, thanks Carol.
